task: ids-model-check flagship: the 20 numeric lists on non-element attributes in no-class specifications (buildable item)

doc_friction.issue: 'The 20 numeric lists on non-element attributes' described them as one untyped group; they were three different cases (derived on a subclass, xs:integer on a NUMBER, list attributes), 12 of which should never become rows. Reading the schema per attribute took the first part of the run.
A heredoc containing fs.rmSync in a JS file tripped the Bash removal safety check; writing the file with the Write tool worked. Worth a line in cloud-session.md.

deviations.why: The item asked to open the 20 lists as rows; 12 are value checks on list attributes that buildingSMART's test case says always fail, so making them editable would help write broken checks.
deviations.did: Opened 8 as rows; kept the 12 held and added an audit warning (not an error, as IDS-Audit-tool accepts the files).
deviations.result: 117 of 129 open (was 109); audit errors unchanged on every corpus; 334/334 test cases.

certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured
